# Improved Baits: Events & Container Datamining

![Improved Lures: Events & Container Datamining](/uploads/525_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

It has been possible to fish in Fallout 76 since June 3rd, 2025. This brings with it a new quest and a new daily. But also numerous new challenges for which you will receive rewards and improvements for your fishing rod. You can find information about this in the “related articles” below.

For fishing, you can use **3 different types of lures**: **Common Lures**, **Improved Lures** and **Premium Lures**. You can simply buy the ordinary ones from the captain and fisherman in Anglers Ruh, but with them you can e.g. not catching axolotls but mostly generic and common fish. You get the first-class bait from the season, there is nothing else available at the moment, so you should be very economical with it. But you can get the improved bait in different places in Fallout 76 and they make it possible to catch all types of fish (including axolotls). Therefore, you will now find data mining with the improved bait here.

## Events with improved lures

Basically all **public events** drop improved bait. This also includes seasonal events. And caravans also offer you improved bait when you complete them.

As you can see from this list, there is no event where you will receive more than 3 baits. All of these events will award you a random amount of between 1 and 3 Improved Lures. Events that are not on this list will not give you improved bait.

## Containers with improved baits

In addition to the events, you also have the opportunity to receive improved bait from containers in the world of Appalachia:

- **Broken refrigerators** (that won't open)
- **Cooler**
- **lunch boxes**

In addition to the locations on the map below, there are also interiors that cannot be found on the map. A good place for broken refrigerators is e.g.

- **Valley Galleria** .
 There is a household appliance store with**16 broken refrigerators**.
- But also **Watoga** offers both refrigerators and coolers with possible upgraded lures.
- **Nuka World** also offers**12 broken refrigerators** with chances for improved bait

The chance of receiving bait from containers is 10%. However, both **improved bait (7.5% chance)** and normal bait spawns (2.5% possible) are possible.

Info: The perk card "Happiness in Cans" **doesn't** help you here, as it only has a small list of pre-war
